summary.probability_distribution: Convolved Negative Binomial per segment with r_inning ≈ 1.0 (r_F5 ≈ 5.0, r_Late4 ≈ 4.0, r_9 ≈ 9.0–10.0); 9-inning ties split 50/50 for win probability; totals and -1.5 runline evaluated on 9-inning grid without extra-inning run accumulation.

structural_flaws_discovered: Zero home-field advantage in run expectation (HCA = 1.000) and 50/50 coin-flip in extra innings, ignoring historical ~53-54% MLB home win rate in tied 9th innings.
ERA displayed in digest has 0.000 weight; 100% of pitching strength comes from FIP.
Rigid hardcoded 5.0 starter / 4.0 bullpen innings split even in ALCS and World Series games where starters routinely exit earlier or pitch deeper.

Totals (Over/Under) and -1.5 Runline percentages are computed on the 9-inning distribution without adding extra-inning runs when tied after 9 innings (~11% of games), systematically underestimating full-game Over probabilities by ~2.5-4.0 percentage points.
Cannot price games using an opener with 0 regular-season starts (hard-failed on ALCS Game 849815 Shawn Armstrong -> astra:data-notice).
2 cancelled/unneeded postseason games (849814 ALCS, 849801 WS) remain stuck in status='upcoming' weeks after the 2026 World Series ended.

claude-haiku-5-5.root_cause_of_nfl_collapse: NFL context.digest omits team names inside ratings.home/away and quarterbacks.home/away, relying solely on 'partido': 'Home Team vs Away Team'. Because US sports convention writes 'Away vs/@ Home', claude-haiku-5-5 inverted home and away in 6/29 (20.69%) NFL games (versus 0/124 in NBA where ratings.home.name explicitly binds the team name).

investigation_5_claude_hallucinations_au.architectural_prompt_vs_model_disconnect: In Football and NBA, the Python LLM script injects external player injury/suspension lists into Claude's JSON prompt even though the underlying mathematical models ignore injuries completely (explicitly admitted in NBA 401909094 and leaked in Football 1494307).
